hideEmptyRootGroups: Hide empty root groups in configurations and extensions by default. A saved project choice overrides this setting; use Use Default Root Filter to reset it.
executable: eska executable name in PATH or absolute path on the workspace host. Arguments are not accepted.
trust: eska runs a local executable and requires a trusted workspace.
virtual: Explorer requires project files on the extension host filesystem.
treeLanguage: Language of metadata groups, module roles and search result types. Auto follows the VS Code language (Russian or English). Applies immediately; object names and other UI text are unchanged.
